title: fix: emit agent tool results as content parts
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Emit agent tool results as `function_call_output.output` content parts (`[{type:"input_text",text}]`) instead of a bare string; Open WebUI iterates the output of every item it receives and crashed with `'str' object has no attribute 'get'` on the first tool call
- Accept replayed history items without `id`/`status`: Open WebUI strips both before replaying a previous turn, and the ingest parsed input with the emitted-item schemas, so every second turn after a tool call failed with `Tool history must contain unique completed function calls`
- `functionOutputText` helper for readers of the output (MCP formatting, ingest, tests)
- Verified on staging gen with the computer-test and pollimcptest agents, including a two-turn replay in Open WebUI's exact shape

gist.headline: Tool calls, properly packed
gist.blurb: Agent tool results now arrive as actual content parts instead of one suspiciously naked string. Open WebUI can replay multi-turn tool conversations without tripping over the packaging.
gist.summary: Agent function-call results now emit as `function_call_output.output` content parts (`[{"type":"input_text","text":...}]`), and replayed Open WebUI history can omit `id` and `status` without failing tool-call validation.
gist.impact: Open WebUI users can run agents through tool calls and replay a second turn in its native history format, without the previous string-parsing crash or `Tool history must contain unique completed function calls` failure.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli carefully packing glowing tool-call notes into labeled, structured content-part envelopes while the eager CRT Monitor Robot reads them cleanly at a retro terminal. A looping garden path represents replayed conversation history finally growing through a second turn without tangling; use small code-plants and orderly pixel cards as symbols of normalized agent output.
